title: Modification of glass reinforced epoxy composites by ammonium polyphosphate (APP) and melamine polyphosphate (PNA) during the resin powder molding process
authors: D. Matykiewicz; B. Przybyszewski; R. Stanik; A. Czulak
source_version: Publisher-labelled accepted manuscript, accepted 2 October 2016; final journal numerical equivalence unverified
TGA_specimen_preparation: Approximately 5 mg of the prepared epoxy/glass composite was placed in a ceramic pan and scanned from 30 to 900 °C at 10 °C/min separately under nitrogen and air. Aliquot cutting or grinding, gas flow, preconditioning and replicate count are unreported.
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Methods: thermal properties of modified epoxy/glass composites; Tables 2 and 3: ASET composites; Figure 2: investigated composites. No precursor powder or separate resin assay is substituted.
LOI_method: Dynisco limiting oxygen index chamber, Germany; ASTM D2863-77; measured LOI
LOI_specimen_preparation: Specimens of the prepared laminate, 125 × 10 × 2 mm. Conditioning, number of specimens and test atmosphere temperature are unreported.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Own Tables 2 and 3 give TG data under nitrogen and air; Table 4 gives measured LOI for the same named laminate states. Original table, method, preparation and Figure 2 pixels inspected; no graph-derived values.
conditions_locator: Accepted manuscript pp 3–5, Table 1 p 4; full PDF pages 4–6
TG_locator: Accepted manuscript Tables 2 and 3 pp 9–10; Figure 2 p 9; TG method p 5 and thermal definitions p 8
LOI_locator: Accepted manuscript Table 4 p 10; method p 5; LOI discussion p 11
source_location: Original accepted manuscript, 22-page PDF including cover and terminal highlights; preparation pp 3–4, TG/LOI methods p 5, thermal discussion p 8, Figure 2/Table 2 p 9, Tables 3/4 p 10, LOI discussion p 11, conclusion pp 15–16 and references pp 16–20.
source_fiber_content_raw: approximately 50 wt% glass in the composites
washing_state: Initial manufactured laminate; no durability wash reported
treatment_method: A.S.SET POWDER 01 epoxy resin (New Era Materials) was mixed with Nord-MIN JLS APP or Nord-MIN JLS PNA (Nordmann Rassmann) in a Retsch GM200 high-speed rotary mixer for 2 min at 2000 rpm. Nominal additive contents of 5, 10 or 20 wt% refer to the total epoxy resin composition. Six sheets of Köper 2/2 woven glass roving fabric, 390 g/m², Panda (R&G Faserverbundwerkstoffe GmbH), each 280 × 280 mm, were covered layer by layer with equal amounts of powder. The source describes approximately 50 wt% glass in the composites. Resin Powder Molding used a Rucks KV284 hydraulic press at 120 °C for 8 min and 20 kN force. The ASET reference used neat epoxy powder in the same composite series. Post-curing, cooling and preconditioning are unreported.
source_T5_definition: Temperature at 5% weight loss; source calls this the initial decomposition temperature.
source_Tmax_definition: TDTG: maximum intensity of thermal degradation temperature, identified from the derivative weight-loss curves. One peak temperature is tabulated per condition despite multiple degradation steps.
Tmax1_assignment: Single source-tabulated maximum-rate temperature; canonical slot 1 does not imply the first chronological degradation step.
source_residue_definition: Residual mass W% defined at 900 °C; total tested composite mass, no glass subtraction or organic-fraction normalization reported.
limitations: The numerical evidence is from the publisher-labelled accepted manuscript associated with this journal DOI. The final journal identity is verified, but numerical equivalence with the final typeset article is unverified; later versions require same-observation reuse review. Both assays refer to the same named manufactured epoxy/glass laminate series. The ASET reference uses neat resin powder as its matrix, and the source repeatedly identifies its finished specimen as an epoxy/glass composite. The approximately 50 wt% glass content is not an exact measured composition and is not used to normalize TG residue. APP/PNA percentages describe the epoxy composition and are not silently converted to total-laminate percentages or retained add-on. Resin chemistry beyond its commercial designation, cooling, any post-curing, TG aliquot cutting or grinding, gas flows, conditioning and TG/LOI replicate counts are unreported. TG residues are source-defined at 900 °C. The one tabulated TDTG is a maximum-rate temperature, not a complete list of the two or three thermal steps. Signed mass-loss rates are preserved as source-native values. The 20APP state is excluded because Table 4 prints LOI 30.1 while the LOI discussion reports an APP maximum of 30.0. The conclusion uses coarser endpoints of 26 and 32 and is not used to overwrite the tabulated values. The thermal prose describes lower treated T5 values and says the trend also occurs in air; the air 5APP and 5PNA table entries instead exceed the control, so those two T5 metrics remain source-native only. The figure axis says mass loss although the traces show remaining mass; values are taken from the explicitly labelled residual-mass tables. No durability wash is reported or assigned.
sample_state: ASET; initial six-ply woven glass/epoxy laminate; epoxy composition with 0 wt% APP and 0 wt% PNA
composition: Six layers of woven glass roving with approximately 50 wt% glass overall; epoxy powder composition contains 0 wt% APP and 0 wt% PNA. These additive percentages refer to the resin composition, not an exact measured whole-laminate loading.
pairing_evidence: Table 1 defines ASET in the finished six-ply epoxy/glass laminate series. Table 4 gives measured LOI 25.9; Table 2 gives the same source label under N2, with source-defined 900 °C residual mass 60.36%. The thermal methods explicitly assay epoxy/glass composites. No separate powder, resin-only or post-wash measurement is introduced.
